notes.title: Thank You
notes.notes:
We would like to thank everybody who has follows Nebulous so far and shown support.  As we are gearing up for the final release we are offering free copies of Nebulous  as well as a Playstation 4, Xbox One, or an Oculus Rift to one lucky winner.

All you need to do is [url=https://namazustudios.wishpond.com/nebulous-comic-con-2016/]Sign Up Here[/url].

For anybody visiting Comic Con this year, we'll be downtown this afternoon.  We hope to see you there!

notes.title: April Early Access Update
notes.notes:
We've updated the game! Here's what's included in the latest:
[list]
    [*]Added levels 4, 8, 14, 18, and 24
    [*]Tutorial accessible from level select
    [*]Voices can now be muted
    [*]New UI design
    [*]Fixed ragdoll bugs
    [*]New graphical effects to improve visuals
    [*]Now uses cloud save
    [*]Oculus VR fixes
[/list]
Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Nebulous Early Access Update
notes.notes:
We've added some new features and levels to Nebulous today!

[list]
    [*] Adjusted Tutorial
[*] Added levels 1, 5, 11, 23, and 27
[*] W, A, S, D now listed in controls section for rotating panels
[*] Screen now fades in and out when using Oculus VR
[*] Fixed VR settings sensitivity
[*] Added controller support
[*] Added windowed mode option
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates!
